Soundboard documentation

Soundboard is a DJ app for iPhone, Android and Mac. One C++ engine does all audio, with a master bus for the room and a separate cue bus for headphones. Thin native apps sit on top, sharing one design system. This page says where each topic lives.

You want toRead

One-minute start

make setup
make validate
make dev

make dev opens the Xcode project on a Mac. Run the Soundboard scheme; import a few audio files from Files; tap Mix.

How headphone cueing works on each platform

Device aloneSplitter cableUSB interface or controllerTwo outputs at once
iPhoneMaster onlyMono master + mono cueYesUSB, HDMI or line-out plus headphones (multi-route)
AndroidMaster onlyYesYesDepends on the phone; checked at runtime
MacTwo devices (speakers + headphone jack)YesYesYes, drift-compensated

Where cueing is not possible, the app says so and still offers sync, visual beat-matching and phrase-aligned automatic transitions. Details and sources: platform audio research.

Source: docs/README.md
